<thought>Retrieve polymorph data for a diverse set of nitride compositions (up to 20, well within the max 40) using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool with the given energy and count limits, storing the JSON files in a dedicated directory within the workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "Li3N",
    "AlN",
    "GaN",
    "InN",
    "BN",
    "Si3N4",
    "TiN",
    "ZrN",
    "HfN",
    "NbN",
    "TaN",
    "MoN",
    "WN",
    "CrN",
    "VN",
    "FeN",
    "CoN",
    "NiN",
    "Mg3N2",
    "Ca3N2"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_10/polymorph_data"
}
</action_input>
